_about: Places researched for a real menu that could not be verified. status: no-menu-online | closed | not-found | wrong-business. 'directory' holds address/phone found in public listings that disagree with our page (not applied: listings can be stale too). Checked dates are when the search was done.

mikes-pizza-restaurant.note: The listed website now redirects to an unrelated business. A Mike's Pizza may be at 1560 Post Rd, Fairfield; not confirmed.

toscana-italian-restaurant.note: Official site refuses automated reads (403); no other menu found.

the-georgetown-owl-saloon-restaurant.note: Instagram only; no menu text online.

viva-zapata.note: No official website or menu found.

early-bird-cafe.note: Only a delivery-app listing (Uber Eats), whose prices are marked up; not used.

anna-liffeys-irish-pub-restaurant.note: No Anna Liffey's in Fairfield found. The only listing is the New Haven pub (17 Whitney Ave), marked permanently closed.

billys-bakery.note: Closed in November 2023 (Patch, Nov 10 2023: 'Billys Bakery is closing its doors today'). The real bakery was at 1885 Black Rock Tpke, not 1270 Post Road.

bills-crossroads-cafe.note: No website or menu found; only directory listings and reviews.

angelos-restaurant.note: Listed website angelosct.com no longer resolves. Only an old third-party SinglePlatform menu (no pizza, very old prices); not used.

berts-deli.note: No website or menu found; directory listings only.

directory.address: 400 Boston Post Rd (Colony Center), Milford, CT 06460

la-fortuna-bar-restaurant.note: Official site lafortunact.com shows a bot-check (CAPTCHA) page, so its menu could not be read. A look-alike page on sot-lafortuna.pages.dev was not used (not the restaurant's domain; menu looks generic).

olde-stratford-ale-house-cafe.note: No business by this name found in Milford or Stratford, CT.

serenata-restaurant.note: No Serenata restaurant in Bridgeport, CT found.

mi-rancho-deli.note: Mexican deli inside a grocery store; no website or published menu (delivery-app listings only).

maks-deli.note: 652 Brooklawn Ave is listed as 'Brooklawn Grocery & Deli'; only an Uber Eats listing (delivery prices), no published menu.

incas-peruvian-restaurant.note: OpenTable marks it permanently closed; its website incasofmilford.com no longer resolves.

heibecks-stand.note: Seasonal roadside stand. No menu on an official site; the only full item list with prices is on delivery apps, which are not used as sources. Call (203) 917-9313.

coffee-an-donut-shop.note: Long-running cash-only donut shop with no website or published menu.

baja-cocina.note: No website or published menu found; directory listings describe a menu board in the shop only, and one listing marks it closed.

elis-tavern.note: Tripadvisor marks it closed; the Eli's Restaurant Group site no longer lists a Milford location, and only old delivery-app menus (June 2022) remain.

the-lantern.note: No official website or menu found. Listings place The Lantern gastropub at 378 Main St, not 37 Danbury Rd.

villa-pizza.note: Only delivery-app menus found (Uber Eats, DoorDash); villapizzeria.com is a parked domain.

salernos-apizza.note: Only an old SinglePlatform listing with dated prices; no official site.

main-wah.note: No Main Wah found in Bridgeport; a directory lists a Main Wah at 1345 Barnum Ave, Stratford, with no menu.

julianos-pizza-restaurant.note: No official menu found. Directories place it at 865 Barnum Ave Cutoff, not 2500 Main St.

planet-pizza.note: Menus only on Slice and MenuPages (marketplaces); no official site found. Phone differs between listings (203-864-4714 / 203-622-0999).

the-villa.note: The Villa Restaurant & Pizza at 4 Riverside Rd appears to have been replaced by HillTop Kitchen; only old newspaper menus remain.

the-benjamin.note: The restaurant's website (thebenjaminrestaurant.com) does not load and its Toast ordering page returns 404. The owners said in 2025 it was not closing, but no current menu could be found.
